body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CI failures introduced by PR #648 (hotcrm submodule removal) by addressing 1 flaky unit test and 6 E2E visual regression test failures.

**Changes:**
- Fixed timing issue in `MobileUX.test.tsx` by using async `findByTestId` instead of `waitFor` + synchronous `getByTestId`
- Added conditional skip guard to `mobile-visual-regression.spec.ts` to prevent failures when baseline snapshots haven't been generated yet
- Updated test count in `ROADMAP.md` to reflect current test suite size (5,070+ tests, 290+ files)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/MobileUX.test.tsx | Replaced flaky synchronous element query with async `findByTestId()` to properly wait for footer element after async rendering |
| e2e/mobile-visual-regression.spec.ts | Added filesystem check and `test.skip()` guard to skip visual regression suite when baseline snapshots are missing, with clear instructions for generating them |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated test count statistics (5,070+ tests, 290+ files) and documented that visual regression baselines are pending generation |
